Reflection and Comprehension: Answer the following guestions using complete sentences.

1. What right does the Fourteenth Amendment give US citizens?

2. What problems did Linda Brown encounter in Topeka that eventually resulted in the case?

3. What precedent did the Plessy v. Ferguson (1896) ruling establish? How was hat precedent related to
Brown v Board of Education (1954)?

4. This case is based on what the concept of “eguality" means. What are the conflicting points of view on this
concept in this case?
